issues.quote: first text only; silence nudge off, forwarding source excluded from the cadence, both existing settings [E43, E44].
issues.concern: E44 holds: excludeSource is a per-team setting (conversation-notifications.service.ts:2634) and the nudge is switched in upsertStlFollowUpConfig (:2408). But whether this combination sends a first text depends on which workflow-creation path the forwarded lead takes, and the doc does not say. The STL first text is sent inline only on the API path (createLeadFollowUpFromLead, sequence-follow-up.controller.ts:37). The SQS path (handleEvent) never sends STL: it records step 1 as 'sqs-stl-deferred-to-api', and when the lead is excluded from follow-up it skips workflow creation entirely (sequence-workflow-creation.service.ts:193 to :208). So if forwarded ADF leads arrive by SQS only, step 0 goes live and sends nothing, silently. On the API path it works: STL fires inline and the cadence tasks fail at execution (orchestrator :1956). The go-live check 'test lead source and type (Q19)' checks fields, not the outcome. Not blocking, because the failure is silent non-contact, not wrong contact, and the BDC still calls next day.
issues.ask: Make the step 0 go-live check an outcome check: one test lead through the real forward gets its first text, and the lead has no scheduled FOLLOW_UP task. Engineering confirms which creation path (API inline or SQS) forwarded ADF leads take, as part of Q19.

issues.quote: first text only; silence nudge off, forwarding source excluded from the cadence, both existing settings [E43, E44].
issues.concern: Both switches are team-wide. E44 itself says the nudge switch is per team, not per source or type, and excludeSource matches on the lead's source string, which other streams at this team may share. If this team already has STL or follow-up running on any other lead stream, step 0 turns those off too. E44 also notes prod values for this team were not checked.
issues.ask: Add to the go-live checks: the CSM reads this team's current STL and follow-up settings in prod and confirms no other lead stream shares the forwarding source or relies on the silence nudge.

issues.concern: This reads as a per-rooftop step 2 item, but opt-out parsing lives in the shared inbound SMS handler (sms.service.ts handleInboundSmsV2, E42), so widening it changes behaviour for every Vini SMS team, sales and service.
